facts.fact: FAO says its Geospatial Unit presented the MerWat-Libya platform, which integrates satellite products with field data to support crop monitoring and water productivity assessment for national institutions in Libya, within an FAO decision support project on irrigation water productivity.

systems.platform: geospatial workspace of satellite products and field data
systems.owner: FAO Geospatial Unit for national institutions

LBY.note: Document mentions only unspecified institutional capacity development, no digital-skills training for civil servants.
Document describes no programme teaching digital skills to the public.
